title: frontloader8s rotten flesh
description: It makes rotten flesh able to craft weapons for beginning of game, middle of game, and end of game. Made using Mcreator.
body: This mod makes rotten flesh a valuable item instead of an obsolete item. This mod allows you to make weapons from rotten flesh that aren't just for the beginning of the game. This mod adds 9 new weapons using rotten flesh to in their recipes. 3 for the begnning of game, 3 for middle of game, and 3 for end of game. Each weapon also has a right click ability. The recipes can be difficult to figure out so i recommend using JEI or EMI. Both mods are great mods that show the recipes for the items you want to craft. This mod is made with Mcreator.
